questions.question: How do I confirm Tesla audio fitment before ordering?
questions.answer: Send the vehicle model, year, trim, factory audio package, and photos of the relevant speaker or amplifier connectors to cs@lightharmonic.com before forcing parts into place.

questions.question: Are Light Harmonic Tesla speaker upgrades DIY friendly?
questions.answer: Most speaker upgrades are designed for DIY installation in the listed Tesla factory locations. Tesla revisions can create small fitment differences, so support photos are useful before installation.

questions.question: Are amplifier upgrades beginner DIY products?
questions.answer: No. TAS amplifier installations are intermediate to advanced work involving amplifier access, trim removal, wiring, and electronics handling. Installation manuals and optional support are available.

questions.question: When should I expect order processing and tracking updates?
questions.answer: Speaker orders usually require three business days for processing and pre-shipment QC. Amplifier or electronic orders usually require up to five business days. Shipping labels may be created before carrier scans begin.

questions.question: What happens if a part does not fit after troubleshooting?
questions.answer: Contact support with photos and order details. If the part cannot be installed after review, Light Harmonic can help arrange the correct replacement or exchange within the policy window.
